task_title: Fix Agent Perf Panel waterfall to a true shared-axis waterfall + add context-window pressure strip

plan_review.notes: 3 rounds w/ gpt-5.4. (1) Waterfall plan: approved_with_changes, 3 concerns (0ms span split, non-finite sanitization, thin renderer coverage) all resolved. (2) Context-chart plan: REJECTED, 3 blocking (no fabricated polyline, unsafe breakdown pairing, x-alignment across containers) + 3 non-blocking (off-axis clamp/flag, budget wording, dot edge clipping) all addressed via stems-only + FIFO pairing + single sticky .wf-head in shared .wf-scroll. (3) Re-review of revised design: approved_with_changes, 2 follow-ups (purely-observational empty-state wording, duplicate-compaction_start test) both resolved.

rounds.notes: Built-in code-review agent (background, high effort) on the uncommitted extension diff. Found 1 Medium bug: in buildContextPoints the FIFO breakdown-pairing loop let ANY compaction consume a compaction_start, so a truncation (by!='auto') interleaved between a start and its owning auto-compaction could steal the breakdown and leave the real auto null. Everything else (no interpolation/stems-only, axis alignment, NaN/Infinity guards, esc() escaping, honest empty-state) checked out.

Fix: gated the compaction_start consumption on u.by==='auto' so truncations never consume/advance the FIFO pointer or receive a breakdown. Added regression test 'does not let an interleaved truncation steal the auto-compaction breakdown' (start@100 / truncation@150 by:'unknown' / auto@200 by:'auto' -> truncation breakdown null, auto gets start@100). Re-review verified the gate correct+complete (real autos are pushed with literal by:'auto', so a legitimate auto can never be mislabeled null; FIFO monotonicity + last-start-wins preserved; broader diff clean). Explicit verdict: no concerns. 44/44 tests pass.
